property_summary: For any owner address and any starting contract balance, when Owner calls withdraw the reference C always results in the contract balance becoming zero (transfer either succeeds or the call reverts), whereas the mutant that uses an unchecked low-level call can return successfully while leaving a nonzero contract balance if the Owner's fallback reverts — so there exist inputs (an adversarial Owner that reverts on receive) that make the mutant leave funds in the contract.
change_summary: Replaced transfer with a low-level call; this changes behavior on failure (no revert) and gas forwarding.
